title: Intercom Conversation Brief
prompt: Brief the selected open billing conversation using its full conversation record. Summarize the customer’s stated issue, prior support context, and unresolved question without replying.
instructions: Find open conversations by subject text and read the selected conversation with get-conversation. Ground the brief only in returned content, distinguish what the customer stated from inferred cause, and say when a detail is absent. Do not reply, add a note, tag the contact, or create a ticket.
fixture_summary: Synthetic search finds one open invoice conversation. Full retrieval shows a duplicate invoice concern and a question about whether a charge is a renewal; no payment record is included.
